vectors.description: A directly-issued, signed delegation bound to the server
vectors.reason: Signature, audience, and shape all valid; no parent to resolve

vectors.description: Root → intermediary → agent with a correctly attenuated child scope
vectors.reason: Linkage, audience, and scope subset all hold across the chain

vectors.description: Child issuerDid does not equal the parent subjectDid
vectors.reason: A broken issuer↔subject link must reject the chain

vectors.description: Child introduces a scope absent from its parent
vectors.reason: A re-delegation may only narrow authority; widening must reject

vectors.description: Child states a scope under a parent that states none
vectors.reason: A parent with no scopes grants none, so a child that states one widens it and must reject

vectors.description: Leaf credential whose Ed25519 proofValue was altered
vectors.reason: A mutated VC signature must fail verification

vectors.description: Credential bound to a different server than the verifier
vectors.reason: Audience binding (confused-deputy guard) must reject a mismatched server

vectors.description: Signed delegation whose credentialSubject.id holds a line feed between two DIDs
vectors.reason: A subject id is held to the rule an issuer is: a URL as it stands, with no character a reader does not see. The verifier hands it on as the acting agent's DID, where a line break forges a line (delegation_malformed)

vectors.description: Signed delegation whose issuanceDate is 2126-01-01, far past the 120 s clock tolerance
vectors.reason: issuanceDate is when the credential becomes valid, held with the clock tolerance a status list's start is, so one beyond it is not yet valid (delegation_not_yet_valid)
